شللتن (form I)
# شَلِلْتُنَّ (šaliltunna) /ʃa.lil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شَلَلْتُنَّ (šalaltunna) /ʃa.lal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شُلِلْتُنَّ (šuliltunna) /ʃu.lil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
